payload.title: auth-service tableData, tableSchema, tenantTables and tenantDatabase implement a generic SELECT * reader over the dedicated tenant schema, which holds every tenant-aware service's tables including payrolls and messages, with no table allowlist, so the D6 and messaging boundaries rest only on auth_service database grants
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/resolvers/tenant-admin.resolver.ts:84 (tableData, and tenantTables at :73, are exposed to TenantAdminOrHigher)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:1255 (allowed schemas are the dedicated tenant schema plus enabled module codes; there is no table allowlist)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:1326 (SELECT * with no row filter on the dedicated tenant schema)
apps/db-migrate/src/tenant-schema-provisioner.ts:966 (every tenant-aware service's migrations are replayed into the one tenant schema, :962-977)
apps/hr-service/src/hr/entities/payroll.entity.ts:161 (payrolls stores earningsBaseSalary as a plain decimal)

apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:290 (tenantDatabase reads pg_tables and pg_stat_user_tables, listing every module table's name, row count and size regardless of grants)
payload.rule_violated: D6 (salary and HR finance are visible only inside HR) and D2, plus the repo rule that each service owns its tables: no generic SQL reader over tenant schemas may exist outside the owning service.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-45, release R7.
